family_reports.body: I went to family court seeking protection for myself and my child and left financially devastated, separated from my child, and stripped of any confidence that the truth mattered. After years of litigation abuse and watching blatant fraud, corruption and illegal activity allowed to continue under the full knowledge of law enforcement and oversight bodies, I hav encountered a system that seemed unwilling to correct itself. I have completely lost faith in the American justice system. I went to court seeking a simple divorce and became a victim of criminal conspiracy involving multiple actors in the Ulster County court system. My child has been irrevocably harmed. There has been no justice or correction. I now warn others to avoid Ulster County at all costs. This is an unsafe place for domestic violence victims, women and children. Not only will they offer no protection, as hundreds of victims here have reported to oversight bodies since 2017, they have created a profitable industry to further victimize women and children seeking protection. Cash for Kids exists in Ulster County, at the detriment to vulnerable families. These same court actors are reaping great profits in a RICO, quid pro quo criminal enterprise that repeatedly uses the same playbook, in the same patterns, in all of the cases.

The family court system subjected my family to years of unnecessary conflict, delay, and financial hardship, while enabling my ex to financially abuse both me and our children for years and failing to hold him accountable.
This court ignored facts, perpetuated FRAUD, conspired to deprive me and my children of life, liberty, justice and our assets, while the stalking and abuse continue.

public_comments.comment_text: He did not issue a ruling in the divorce trial until nine months after the conclusion of the trial and submission of the case. He also disclosed that he knew the defendant's mother. Although he stated that he would impose penalty fees against my ex for financial abuse and failure to pay daycare expenses, he never did so. Additionally, he did not award either parent final legal decision-making authority, despite the Attorney for the Children stating in her closing argument that the mother should have final decision-making authority because the father was unlikely to follow the recommendations of medical professionals. Throughout the proceedings, he observed my ex hire and fire four attorneys before ultimately representing himself at trial.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent
